assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission for submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Official SITE_BOUNDARY and KEY_AREA redlines are not yet available; provisional constraint polygons from the site package are used and fully labeled.
assumptions.impact: All boundary and area metrics must be recalculated when official polygons are published; provisional polygons are not official redlines.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints, heights, FAR, and demolition/renovation classifications are indicative design intent, not statutory or engineering conclusions.
assumptions.impact: Floor area and FAR metrics remain unknown until official regulatory conditions are confirmed.

assumptions.statement: The primary narrative is Chinese; proposal.en.md and all en counterparts (HTML, drawings, text-bearing figures) are maintained in parallel.
assumptions.impact: Sections, claims, metrics, evidence references, and figure positions stay aligned between languages.
